description: Auditable external SQL corpora for Phase 1. Sources are intentionally stratified: Spider cross-domain text-to-SQL, real tutorial repositories, and JOIN/window/CTE-focused teaching files are all enabled.

sources.name: WikiSQL official archive
sources.license_note: Use according to the upstream WikiSQL repository terms.
sources.bias_risk: Single-table benchmark distribution; useful for projection, aggregation and simple predicates but insufficient for joins, nesting, windows and dialect edges.

sources.name: Spider benchmark (Hugging Face mirror, train)
sources.license_note: Spider is distributed under its upstream license; the mirror is used only as a source of SQL examples.
sources.bias_risk: Cross-domain benchmark distribution; replay requires the official Spider tables.json keyed by db_id, and records without a physical schema are rejected.

sources.name: Spider benchmark (Hugging Face mirror, validation)
sources.license_note: Spider is distributed under its upstream license; the mirror is used only as a source of SQL examples.
sources.bias_risk: Cross-domain benchmark distribution; replay requires the official Spider tables.json keyed by db_id, and records without a physical schema are rejected.

sources.name: WikiSQL-derived Phase 1 local snapshot
sources.license_note: Source-level URL is retained for the derived snapshot; row-level upstream URL was not retained by the previous snapshot builder.
sources.provenance_note: Derived snapshot of the WikiSQL stratum; do not treat the local file as an independent external source.
sources.bias_risk: Single-table WikiSQL distribution; source-level provenance is available but row-level URL fidelity is incomplete.

sources.name: Previously mined public SQL teaching corpus
sources.provenance_note: Imported local snapshot; individual upstream URLs were absent in the retained records and are reported as missing_upstream_record.
sources.license_note: Locally retained provenance points to the upstream URLs in each record.
sources.bias_risk: Mined and prefiltered corpus; must remain a minority source in stratified sampling.

sources.name: PostgreSQL Exercises
sources.license_note: BSD-style license in the upstream root; question assets also carry their own upstream license file.
sources.bias_risk: Curated PostgreSQL teaching exercises over one club schema; broad joins, aggregates, strings, dates and recursive CTEs but not a production distribution.

sources.name: XD-DENG SQL Exercise
sources.license_note: No repository license was declared when collected; use is limited to transient local evaluation and raw content is not redistributed.
sources.bias_risk: Wikibooks-derived answer sheets often contain multiple valid alternatives per question and several dialect variants.

sources.name: Rafael SQL Exercises
sources.license_note: MIT license in the upstream repository.
sources.bias_risk: Thirty exercises over one education star schema; useful for CASE, joins, aggregates, windows and CTEs.

sources.name: SQL 100 Exercises - basic select
sources.license_note: CC0-1.0 license in the upstream repository.
sources.bias_risk: Small PostgreSQL-focused basic chapter over a Japanese corporate registry schema; includes vendor-specific GROUPING SETS and NULL ordering.

sources.name: 8 Week SQL Challenge
sources.license_note: MIT license in the upstream repository.
sources.bias_risk: The public repository provides case-study questions and sample data but not canonical answer SQL; it is not admissible as a standard-answer corpus.
